objects.query: SELECT ConfigureDuringSale, CurrencyIsoCode, Description, Id, IsActive, IsSoldOnlyWithOtherProds, Name, ProductCode, QuantityUnitOfMeasure, StockKeepingUnit FROM Product2 WHERE StockKeepingUnit IN ('SMX-SVC-TRN-DAY', 'SMX-SVC-SAT') ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC

SELECT Id, IsDefault, Product2Id, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModelId, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM ProductSellingModelOption WHERE Product2.StockKeepingUnit IN ('SMX-SVC-TRN-DAY', 'SMX-SVC-SAT') ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC

SELECT CurrencyIsoCode, Id, IsActive, Pricebook2Id, Pricebook2.Name, Product2Id, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModelId, ProductSellingModel.Name, UnitPrice FROM PricebookEntry WHERE Product2.StockKeepingUnit IN ('SMX-SVC-TRN-DAY', 'SMX-SVC-SAT') ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, Pricebook2.Name ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode ASC

SELECT Id, IsPrimaryCategory, ProductCategoryId, ProductCategory.Name, ProductId, Product.StockKeepingUnit FROM ProductCategoryProduct WHERE Product.StockKeepingUnit IN ('SMX-SVC-TRN-DAY', 'SMX-SVC-SAT') ORDER BY ProductCategory.Name ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC
